id.radarDesc: Kontrak kerja 2 tahun dengan fasilitas perlindungan asuransi penuh, akomodasi, dan makan.
id.title: Domestic Worker / Caregiver
id.jobDescription: Pekerja bertanggung jawab atas operasional rumah tangga harian, termasuk menjaga kebersihan lingkungan rumah tangga. Peran ini juga mencakup tugas perawatan (caregiving) untuk lansia atau anak-anak, memasak, dan manajemen rumah tangga sesuai instruksi pemberi kerja.
requirements: Memiliki kemampuan dasar bahasa Inggris, Melayu, atau Indonesia
benefits: Gaji kotor SGD 600 - SGD 1.000 per bulan
Tiket kepulangan ditanggung pemberi kerja setelah kontrak selesai

en.radarDesc: 2-year employment contract with full insurance coverage, accommodation, and meals provided.
en.title: Domestic Worker / Caregiver
en.jobDescription: The worker will be responsible for household chores, caring for elderly/children, and other domestic duties as assigned. Skills required include household management, caregiving, and cooking.
benefits: Gross salary SGD 600 - SGD 1,000 per month
Return ticket provided by employer after contract completion

id.radarDesc: Program seasonal elit 6-8 bulan untuk Spa Therapist di Turki.
id.title: Spa Therapist & Turkish Bath Scrub Attendant
id.jobDescription: Program kerja musiman (seasonal) selama 6-8 bulan dengan penempatan di berbagai hotel mewah dan spa di area pariwisata elit Turki. Posisi ini menuntut standar pelayanan dan keramahtamahan internasional tingkat tinggi.
requirements: Memiliki kemampuan berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa Inggris
Usia sekitar 25–35 tahun untuk beberapa kebutuhan
benefits: Gaji USD 700–750 (Setara Rp 13 Jt) per bulan

en.radarDesc: Elite 6-8 months seasonal program for Spa Therapists in Turkey.
en.title: Spa Therapist & Turkish Bath Scrub Attendant
en.jobDescription: A 6-8 month seasonal employment program placed in luxury hotels and spas across Turkey's elite tourism areas. This position requires high international service and hospitality standards.
requirements: Good appearance and excellent service attitude

id.radarDesc: Program seasonal 6-8 bulan. Tersedia kuota 200 orang untuk Housekeeping, Waiter, Steward, dll.
id.title: Hotel Operations
id.jobDescription: Program kerja musiman (seasonal) perhotelan selama 6-8 bulan dengan penempatan di berbagai hotel di Turki. Terbuka total kuota 200 orang untuk berbagai divisi perhotelan (Housekeeping, Steward, Cook Assistant, Bartender, Butler, Bellboy/girl, dan Waiter/ss).
requirements: Pria dan Wanita (Kuota: Housekeeping 15 Pria/35 Wanita, Steward 50 Pria, Waiter/ss 25 Pria/25 Wanita, Lain-lain 50 orang)
Pengalaman di bidang hospitality atau operasional perhotelan
Kemampuan bahasa asing dasar sesuai kebutuhan posisi
benefits: Gaji USD 650 per bulan NETT (Setara Rp 11.600.000)
Penempatan resmi di hotel-hotel terkemuka Turki

en.radarDesc: 6-8 months seasonal program. 200 quota available for Housekeeping, Waiter, Steward, and more.
en.title: Hotel Operations
en.jobDescription: A 6-8 month seasonal hotel operations program with placement in various hotels across Turkey. A total quota of 200 people is open for multiple hospitality divisions including Housekeeping, Steward, Cook Assistant, Bartender, Butler, Bellboy/girl, and Waiter/ss.
requirements: Male and Female (Quota: Housekeeping 15M/35F, Steward 50M, Waiter/ss 25M/25F, Others 50)
Experience in hospitality or hotel operations
Basic foreign language skills according to the position
Ready for a 6-8 month seasonal contract
benefits: Salary USD 650 per month NETT (Approx. IDR 11,600,000)
Local transportation within the hotel area
Official placement in leading hotels in Turkey

id.radarDesc: Jalur resmi KP2MI tanpa biaya penempatan (Zero Cost). Termasuk asrama dan sertifikasi BNSP.
id.title: General Worker (Jalur Resmi KP2MI)
id.jobDescription: Kesempatan kerja resmi ke Malaysia melalui P3MI berlisensi dengan estimasi keberangkatan 2-3 bulan sejak wawancara awal. Proses meliputi wawancara user, penandatanganan kontrak kerja, dan pelatihan intensif di asrama untuk mendapatkan sertifikasi BNSP sebelum keberangkatan.
requirements: Serius, disiplin, sopan, dan siap mengikuti prosedur

en.radarDesc: Official KP2MI zero-cost placement track. Includes dormitory and BNSP certification.
en.title: General Worker (Official KP2MI Track)
en.jobDescription: Official employment opportunity in Malaysia through a licensed P3MI. The process takes an estimated 2-3 months from the initial interview and includes user interviews, contract signing, and intensive dormitory training to obtain BNSP certification prior to departure.
requirements: Serious, disciplined, polite, and ready to follow procedures
benefits: Free dormitory after signing the employment contract
Official work contract signed prior to departure
